A federal judge allowed two claims to proceed against Bank of America (NYSE:BAC) in a lawsuit tied to Jeffrey Epstein, while dismissing four others. The decision means Bank of America will continue to face litigation related to its historical dealings with Epstein. The ruling keeps legal, financial, and reputational questions around the bank's past client relationships in focus for stakeholders.
